scope: Isolated fixtures; no production database or email delivery verification

completion.name: Backup and archive action controls use the semantic output colors
Settings card headers share the 56px minimum and retain 3px edges
Phone and navigation controls retain their approved appearance
All News has one list with upcoming, undated and past items in the requested order
Reviewed news remains visible and unconfirmed dates cannot be approved
Dismiss marks news in the same list without deleting it or changing attendance
Calendar review opens the same flat list and preserves explicit approval
A changed news revision requires a new review while all items remain visible
News layouts fit desktop and tablet without filters
Changed desktop assets share release versions while phone runtime keeps its own cache version

regression.name: Editing during the first save retains the saved ID and leaves newer edits dirty
A lost reply after insertion retries the same durable ID
Editable budget dates validate month lengths and leap years
Rapid allocation attempts cannot release the active save lock
Finalization form rows and module headers fit desktop and tablet widths
Action colors distinguish save, add, templates, delete and reset
Payroll and Reports navigation chords never trigger printing
Editor uses E then File F Open O and unique Insert Table commands
The same editor chords work from the editable iframe without print leakage
Closing warns, requires acknowledgment, allows override and can be cancelled
Deferred preparation chooses the next open month and keeps original dates

closingDatabase.name: Closing preflight lists exact dated unposted reports
Direct closing and unacknowledged overrides are rejected
Changed pending data requires a new acknowledgment
Acknowledged close and lock retain unaccepted reports and record the audit
Deferred summaries post into the next open period with original dates and IDs
Closed target periods and backdating remain blocked
Open source months keep their original posting month
Correction-session close uses the same acknowledgment and retains pending reports
Year closing retains the installed fingerprint check and all month acknowledgments
Sub-users cannot acknowledge or close accounting periods
